en.greeting: Hi! At B2 you linked sentences with although, despite and nevertheless. Today we'll make whole texts hang together: formal connectors, clear reference words and signposts for long reports.

steps.title: What makes a text hang together
steps.text: Quick recap from B2: **although** + subject + verb, **despite** + a noun, **whereas** to compare two facts, **Nevertheless,** + a new sentence. Now let's make whole texts flow.
steps.body:
**Cohesion** = a text that hangs together: the reader always knows what *this* or *it* points to, and where the argument is going. Three tools:
- **formal connectors** that show the logic: *albeit, notwithstanding, insofar as, hence*
- **reference words** that point back clearly: *the former / the latter, this approach*
- **signposts** that show the map of a long text: *Turning now to …, As outlined above, …*

They're formal: for reports, essays and theses. In a chat, *but, so, also* stay natural.

steps.title: albeit, notwithstanding, insofar as
steps.text: Three formal connectors. As at B2, the grammar after them decides.
steps.body:
- **albeit** (*meskipun*) + an adjective, adverb or noun phrase, NOT a full clause (subject + verb): *effective,* **albeit expensive** ✓, `albeit it was expensive` ✗.
- **notwithstanding** (*terlepas dari*) + a noun, like *despite*: *Notwithstanding the costs, …* or *the costs notwithstanding*. Never `notwithstanding of` ✗.
- **insofar as** (*sejauh / sepanjang*) + subject + verb = to the extent that. British English also writes *in so far as*.

pairs.id: meskipun mahal (+ kata sifat, bukan klausa)
sejauh biayanya turun (+ subjek + kata kerja)

pairs.en: The trial was a success, albeit a short one.
Notwithstanding the costs, the ministry approved the project.
pairs.id: Meskipun biayanya besar, kementerian menyetujui proyek itu.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: Dr. Wulan is writing a report on a new grading system at her university. Look at what comes after the gap, and at the meaning.

question.prompt: The new grading system is fair ___ every student is marked against the same criteria. However, it creates a lot of extra work for lecturers.
question.explanation: After the gap comes a subject + verb (*every student is marked*), and the meaning is 'fair to the extent that': **insofar as**. *albeit* takes only a short phrase, not a clause, and *notwithstanding* needs a noun and means 'despite', which doesn't fit.

steps.title: hence, thus, whereby, in that
steps.text: Four more formal connectors, and one Indonesian trap.
steps.body:
- **Hence / Thus,** (*oleh karena itu*) = very formal *therefore*. **hence** + a noun = that's why: *Sales fell; hence the job cuts.*
- **whereby** (*yang dengannya*) after a noun like *scheme, system, agreement* = by which: *a scheme whereby staff can work from home*.
- **in that** (*dalam arti bahwa*) + subject + verb explains **in what way** something is true: *The plan is risky in that it depends on one supplier.*

Trap: *Meskipun …, tetapi …* → `Although …, but …` ✗. English uses **one** linker.

pairs.en: a scheme whereby staff can work from home
pairs.id: skema yang memungkinkan staf bekerja dari rumah

pairs.en: risky in that it depends on one supplier
pairs.id: berisiko dalam arti bergantung pada satu pemasok

pairs.en: Although the plan is risky, it is worth trying.
pairs.id: Meskipun berisiko, rencana itu layak dicoba. (satu kata penghubung)

steps.title: Spot the correct sentence
steps.text: Budi is checking a press release for a startup in Jakarta. Two sentences have a common C1 mistake.

options: The launch was successful, albeit it was two weeks late.
Notwithstanding of the delay, the launch was successful.
The launch was successful, albeit two weeks late.
question.explanation: **albeit** + a short phrase (*two weeks late*), with no subject + verb. The first sentence puts a clause (*it was two weeks late*) after albeit. The second adds *of*: it's *notwithstanding the delay*, with no *of*.

steps.title: Pointing back clearly
steps.text: In a long text you keep pointing back. Make sure the reader knows exactly to what.
steps.body:
- **the former** (*yang pertama*) / **the latter** (*yang kedua*): only for exactly **two** things. With three or more: *the first / the last*, or the name.
- **this / these + a summary noun** (a noun that sums up the idea): *this approach, this trend, these findings*; **such a view**, **such measures**.
- A bare *this* or *it* can point to two things: *The ministry cut the budget and raised fees. This angered students.* Which? → *This fee rise …*

Trap: *hal ini / hal tersebut* → name the thing, not `this matter` every time.

pairs.en: Staff can travel by MRT or by car. The former is faster in the rush hour.
pairs.id: Staf bisa naik MRT atau mobil. Yang pertama (MRT) lebih cepat saat jam sibuk.

steps.title: Which one do you mean?
steps.text: Pak Hasan is summarising a city council decision in Yogyakarta. Think about which option was first and which was cheaper.

question.prompt: The council had two options for the old market: to rebuild it or to turn it into a park. ___ would have cost Rp 40 billion, so the council chose the park.
question.explanation: The expensive option is the one the council did NOT choose: rebuilding, which was mentioned first, so **The former**. *The latter* would be the park, which the council chose. A bare *This* could point to either option.

steps.title: A report that guides the reader
steps.text: Here are the signposts from a report on a four-day week trial at a startup in Bandung.
steps.body: Signposts are the map: what comes next (*Turning now to …*), what came before (*As outlined above, …*), what comes later (*As will be discussed below, …*) and where we are (*To return to the main point, … / In summary, …*). In writing, **above** = earlier and **below** = later; in a talk, say *as I mentioned earlier*.

examples.en: This report looks at a four-day week trial at a startup in Bandung.
examples.id: Laporan ini membahas uji coba empat hari kerja seminggu di sebuah startup di Bandung.

examples.en: As outlined above, 40 staff took part for six months.
examples.id: Seperti diuraikan di atas, 40 staf ikut serta selama enam bulan.

examples.en: Having considered the benefits, we now turn to the risks.
examples.id: Setelah membahas manfaatnya, sekarang kita beralih ke risikonya.

examples.en: As will be discussed below, some clients were unhappy.
examples.id: Seperti yang akan dibahas di bawah, beberapa klien tidak puas.

examples.en: To return to the main point, output did not fall.
examples.id: Kembali ke poin utama, hasil kerja tidak turun.

steps.title: Point forward
steps.text: Sari is writing the introduction to a report for an NGO in Surabaya. She wants to tell the reader that the risks come later in the report.

question.prompt: Arrange the words to point forward to a later part of the report.
question.solution: These risks will be discussed below.
question.explanation: **below** points forward to a later part of a written text (**above** points back). *These risks* is these + a summary noun, and *will be discussed* is the future passive.

steps.title: Put the signposts in order
steps.text: Three sentences from one report by Bu Ani. Think about where each signpost belongs.

question.prompt: In which order do these sentences appear in the report? (1) In summary, the new shift system has cut overtime by 20%. (2) This report examines the new shift system at a factory in Surabaya. (3) Turning now to the costs, the system required new software.
question.explanation: **This report examines …** opens the report and says what it does. **Turning now to …** moves to a new topic in the middle. **In summary, …** closes it.

steps.title: Cheat sheet
steps.text: Here's the whole lesson on one page.

artifact.title: Cheat sheet · cohesion and discourse markers
artifact.intro: Formal connectors: check what comes after them. Reference: make sure the reader knows what you point to. Signposts: show the map of a long text.
rows: Notwithstanding the costs, … / The costs notwithstanding, …
fair insofar as everyone pays the same rate
in what way it's true · formal
risky in that it depends on one supplier
Sales fell; hence the job cuts.
a scheme whereby staff work from home
MRT or car? The former is faster.
this approach, this trend, these findings
such a + one thing; such + plural
Having considered X, we now turn to Y.
Having considered the benefits, we now turn to the risks.
As outlined above, 40 staff took part.
As will be discussed below, some clients were unhappy.
To return to the main point, … / In summary, …
In summary, the trial was a success.
tips: One linker per sentence: not `Although …, but …` (Meskipun …, tetapi …).
Not `albeit it was expensive`, not `notwithstanding of`, not the former / the latter for three things.
Replace a vague This or it with this + a noun (this fee rise) or a name.

examples.en: The bad weather notwithstanding, the festival went ahead.
examples.id: Terlepas dari cuaca buruk, festivalnya tetap berlangsung.

examples.en: The two cities are similar in that both grew around a port.
examples.id: Kedua kota itu mirip dalam arti keduanya tumbuh di sekitar pelabuhan.

examples.en: Online shopping keeps growing. This trend has hit small shops hard.
examples.id: Belanja online terus tumbuh. Tren ini sangat memukul toko-toko kecil.

steps.title: Learn more
steps.text: Two British Council C1 model essays: one uses the former and the latter and Hence; the other shows signposts that organise a whole essay.

id.greeting: Hai! Di B2 kamu sudah menyambung kalimat dengan although, despite dan nevertheless. Hari ini kita buat teks utuh yang menyambung: kata penghubung formal, kata rujukan yang jelas dan penunjuk arah untuk laporan panjang.

steps.title: Apa yang membuat teks menyambung
steps.text: Ulasan singkat dari B2: **although** + subjek + kata kerja, **despite** + kata benda, **whereas** untuk membandingkan dua fakta, **Nevertheless,** + kalimat baru. Sekarang kita buat teks utuh mengalir.
steps.body:
**Kohesi** (cohesion) = teks yang menyambung: pembaca selalu tahu *this* atau *it* merujuk ke apa, dan argumennya bergerak ke mana. Tiga alat:
- **kata penghubung formal** yang menunjukkan logikanya: *albeit, notwithstanding, insofar as, hence*
- **kata rujukan** yang merujuk balik dengan jelas: *the former / the latter, this approach*
- **penunjuk arah** (signpost) yang menunjukkan peta teks panjang: *Turning now to …, As outlined above, …*

Semuanya formal: untuk laporan, esai dan skripsi. Di chat, *but, so, also* tetap wajar.

steps.title: albeit, notwithstanding, insofar as
steps.text: Tiga kata penghubung formal. Seperti di B2, tata bahasa setelahnya yang menentukan.
steps.body:
- **albeit** (*meskipun*) + kata sifat, kata keterangan atau frasa kata benda, BUKAN klausa lengkap (subjek + kata kerja): *effective,* **albeit expensive** ✓, `albeit it was expensive` ✗.
- **notwithstanding** (*terlepas dari*) + kata benda, seperti *despite*: *Notwithstanding the costs, …* atau *the costs notwithstanding*. Tidak pernah `notwithstanding of` ✗.
- **insofar as** (*sejauh / sepanjang*) + subjek + kata kerja = to the extent that. British juga menulis *in so far as*.

pairs.id: meskipun mahal (+ kata sifat, bukan klausa)
sejauh biayanya turun (+ subjek + kata kerja)

pairs.en: The trial was a success, albeit a short one.
Notwithstanding the costs, the ministry approved the project.
pairs.id: Meskipun biayanya besar, kementerian menyetujui proyek itu.

steps.title: Giliranmu
steps.text: Dr. Wulan sedang menulis laporan tentang sistem penilaian baru di kampusnya. Lihat apa yang datang setelah titik-titiknya, dan artinya.

question.prompt: Lengkapi: The new grading system is fair ___ every student is marked against the same criteria. However, it creates a lot of extra work for lecturers.
question.explanation: Setelah titik-titiknya ada subjek + kata kerja (*every student is marked*), dan artinya 'adil sejauh …': **insofar as**. *albeit* hanya bisa diikuti frasa pendek, bukan klausa, dan *notwithstanding* butuh kata benda dan artinya 'meskipun ada', jadi tidak cocok.

steps.title: hence, thus, whereby, in that
steps.text: Empat kata penghubung formal lagi, dan satu jebakan bahasa Indonesia.
steps.body:
- **Hence / Thus,** (*oleh karena itu*) = *therefore* yang sangat formal. **hence** + kata benda = itulah sebabnya: *Sales fell; hence the job cuts.*
- **whereby** (*yang dengannya*) setelah kata benda seperti *scheme, system, agreement* = by which: *a scheme whereby staff can work from home*.
- **in that** (*dalam arti bahwa*) + subjek + kata kerja menjelaskan **dalam hal apa** sesuatu benar: *The plan is risky in that it depends on one supplier.*

Jebakan: *Meskipun …, tetapi …* → `Although …, but …` ✗. Bahasa Inggris memakai **satu** kata penghubung.

pairs.en: a scheme whereby staff can work from home
pairs.id: skema yang memungkinkan staf bekerja dari rumah

pairs.en: risky in that it depends on one supplier
pairs.id: berisiko dalam arti bergantung pada satu pemasok

pairs.en: Although the plan is risky, it is worth trying.
pairs.id: Meskipun berisiko, rencana itu layak dicoba. (satu kata penghubung)

steps.title: Temukan kalimat yang benar
steps.text: Budi sedang memeriksa siaran pers untuk sebuah startup di Jakarta. Dua kalimat punya kesalahan C1 yang umum.

options: The launch was successful, albeit it was two weeks late.
Notwithstanding of the delay, the launch was successful.
The launch was successful, albeit two weeks late.
question.explanation: **albeit** + frasa pendek (*two weeks late*), tanpa subjek + kata kerja. Kalimat pertama menaruh klausa (*it was two weeks late*) setelah albeit. Kalimat kedua menambah *of*: yang benar *notwithstanding the delay*, tanpa *of*.

steps.title: Merujuk balik dengan jelas
steps.text: Di teks panjang kamu terus merujuk balik. Pastikan pembaca tahu persis ke apa.
steps.body:
- **the former** (*yang pertama*) / **the latter** (*yang kedua*): hanya untuk tepat **dua** hal. Kalau tiga atau lebih: *the first / the last*, atau sebut namanya.
- **this / these + kata benda perangkum** (kata benda yang merangkum ide sebelumnya): *this approach, this trend, these findings*; **such a view**, **such measures**.
- *this* atau *it* saja bisa merujuk ke dua hal: *The ministry cut the budget and raised fees. This angered students.* Yang mana? → *This fee rise …*

Jebakan: *hal ini / hal tersebut* → sebut bendanya, jangan `this matter` terus-menerus.

pairs.en: Staff can travel by MRT or by car. The former is faster in the rush hour.
pairs.id: Staf bisa naik MRT atau mobil. Yang pertama (MRT) lebih cepat saat jam sibuk.

steps.title: Yang mana maksudmu?
steps.text: Pak Hasan sedang merangkum keputusan dewan kota di Yogyakarta. Pikirkan pilihan mana yang disebut duluan dan mana yang lebih murah.

question.prompt: Lengkapi: The council had two options for the old market: to rebuild it or to turn it into a park. ___ would have cost Rp 40 billion, so the council chose the park.
question.explanation: Pilihan yang mahal adalah yang TIDAK dipilih dewan: membangun ulang, yang disebut duluan, jadi **The former**. *The latter* adalah taman, yang justru dipilih. *This* saja bisa merujuk ke pilihan mana pun.

steps.title: Laporan yang memandu pembaca
steps.text: Ini penunjuk arah dari laporan tentang uji coba empat hari kerja seminggu di sebuah startup di Bandung.
steps.body: Penunjuk arah adalah petanya: apa yang berikutnya (*Turning now to …*), apa yang sudah dibahas (*As outlined above, …*), apa yang dibahas nanti (*As will be discussed below, …*) dan di mana kita sekarang (*To return to the main point, … / In summary, …*). Dalam tulisan, **above** = sebelumnya dan **below** = nanti; dalam presentasi, katakan *as I mentioned earlier*.

examples.en: This report looks at a four-day week trial at a startup in Bandung.
examples.id: Laporan ini membahas uji coba empat hari kerja seminggu di sebuah startup di Bandung.

examples.en: As outlined above, 40 staff took part for six months.
examples.id: Seperti diuraikan di atas, 40 staf ikut serta selama enam bulan.

examples.en: Having considered the benefits, we now turn to the risks.
examples.id: Setelah membahas manfaatnya, sekarang kita beralih ke risikonya.

examples.en: As will be discussed below, some clients were unhappy.
examples.id: Seperti yang akan dibahas di bawah, beberapa klien tidak puas.

examples.en: To return to the main point, output did not fall.
examples.id: Kembali ke poin utama, hasil kerja tidak turun.

steps.title: Merujuk ke depan
steps.text: Sari sedang menulis pendahuluan laporan untuk sebuah LSM di Surabaya. Ia ingin memberi tahu pembaca bahwa risikonya dibahas nanti di laporan.

question.prompt: Susun kata-katanya untuk merujuk ke bagian laporan yang datang nanti.
question.solution: These risks will be discussed below.
question.explanation: **below** merujuk ke bagian tulisan yang datang nanti (**above** merujuk ke belakang). *These risks* adalah these + kata benda perangkum, dan *will be discussed* adalah pasif bentuk future.

steps.title: Urutkan penunjuk arahnya
steps.text: Tiga kalimat dari satu laporan Bu Ani. Pikirkan di mana tempat tiap penunjuk arah.

question.prompt: Dalam urutan apa kalimat-kalimat ini muncul di laporan? (1) In summary, the new shift system has cut overtime by 20%. (2) This report examines the new shift system at a factory in Surabaya. (3) Turning now to the costs, the system required new software.
question.explanation: **This report examines …** membuka laporan dan menyebut apa yang dibahasnya. **Turning now to …** pindah ke topik baru di tengah. **In summary, …** menutupnya.

steps.title: Ringkasan
steps.text: Ini seluruh pelajaran dalam satu halaman.

artifact.title: Ringkasan · kohesi dan penanda wacana
artifact.intro: Kata penghubung formal: cek apa yang datang setelahnya. Rujukan: pastikan pembaca tahu apa yang kamu rujuk. Penunjuk arah: tunjukkan peta teks panjang.
rows: + kata sifat / kata keterangan / frasa kata benda
Notwithstanding the costs, … / The costs notwithstanding, …
fair insofar as everyone pays the same rate
risky in that it depends on one supplier
hence + kata benda; Thus, + kalimat baru
Sales fell; hence the job cuts.
kata benda + whereby + subjek + kata kerja
a scheme whereby staff work from home
MRT or car? The former is faster.
this approach, this trend, these findings
such a + satu hal; such + jamak
Having considered X, we now turn to Y.
Having considered the benefits, we now turn to the risks.
As outlined above, 40 staff took part.
As will be discussed below, some clients were unhappy.
To return to the main point, … / In summary, …
In summary, the trial was a success.
tips: Satu kata penghubung per kalimat: bukan `Although …, but …` (Meskipun …, tetapi …).
Bukan `albeit it was expensive`, bukan `notwithstanding of`, bukan the former / the latter untuk tiga hal.
Ganti This atau it yang kabur dengan this + kata benda (this fee rise) atau nama.

steps.text: Dua contoh esai C1 dari British Council: satu memakai the former, the latter dan Hence; yang lain menunjukkan penunjuk arah yang menata seluruh esai.
